title: MVC Pattern: Model, View aur Controller
objectives: MVC ka matlab aur teen roles samajhna
Laravel mein Model, View, Controller ki files kahan hoti hain jaanna
Ek request ko route se view tak follow karna
Business logic controller mein kyun nahi bharni chahiye samajhna

sections.heading: MVC kya hai?
sections.body:
MVC ek design pattern hai jo code ko teen hisson mein baantta hai:

- **Model** – data aur database ka kaam (Product, User)
- **View** – user ko jo dikhta hai (HTML page)
- **Controller** – request lekar Model se baat karta hai aur View ko data deta hai

Fayda: har hissa ek kaam karta hai, isliye code padhna aur badalna aasan hota hai.

callout.text: Restaurant yaad karo: Controller kitchen head hai, Model store-room, View plate. Waiter (Route) in sab ko jodta hai.

sections.heading: Laravel mein files kahan hoti hain?
sections.body:
Laravel MVC ko flexible tareeke se follow karta hai. Default jagahein:

- Model: `app/Models/Product.php`
- View: `resources/views/products/show.blade.php`
- Controller: `app/Http/Controllers/ProductController.php`
- Route: `routes/web.php`

Yeh files `php artisan make:model`, `make:controller` se banti hain.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Product detail page
sections.body: Customer `/products/5` kholta hai. Route request controller ko deta hai. Controller model se product 5 maangta hai, aur view ko deta hai jo page banata hai. Eloquent (Model) aur Blade (View) ki detail aage ke modules mein aayegi, abhi sirf flow samjho.

code.code:
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Product;

class ProductController extends Controller
{
    public function show(int $id)
    {
        $product = Product::findOrFail($id);

        return view('products.show', ['product' => $product]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Product extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = ['name', 'price'];
}

explain: Route sirf URL ko `ProductController@show` se jodta hai.
Controller: `Product::findOrFail($id)` – product na mile to automatically 404.
Model `Product` database table `products` se baat karta hai (naam se pata chalta hai).
Blade mein `{{ $product->name }}` data print karta hai.

sections.heading: Fat controller se bacho
sections.body: Beginners sab kuch controller mein likh dete hain: validation, calculation, email. Isse controller bahut bhari ho jaata hai. Rule: **controller patla rakho**. Business logic Model, Service class ya Action class mein rakho (Module 23 mein detail).

callout.text: Controller ka kaam: request lena, kisi aur class se kaam karwana, response dena. Calculation aur database ki lambi logic controller mein mat bharo.

versionDiff.heading: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13 mein Controller
versionDiff.intro: MVC ka concept teeno versions mein same hai. Base Controller class mein farak hai.

items.11: Base `Controller` ek khali abstract class hai. Controller middleware ke liye route par `->middleware()` ya controller mein `HasMiddleware` interface use karte hain (Module 04 aur 13).
items.13: Same default. 13 docs mein controller par `#[Middleware]` aur `#[Authorize]` attributes bhi hain (optional). Detail Module 04 mein.

errors.cause: Model file nahi bani, ya namespace/naam galat hai.
errors.fix: `php artisan make:model Product` chalao aur `use App\Models\Product;` check karo.

errors.cause: View ka naam aur file path match nahi karte.
errors.fix: `products.show` ka matlab `resources/views/products/show.blade.php`. Folder aur file ka naam dekho.

errors.cause: `findOrFail()` ko id 5 wala record nahi mila, isliye 404 aaya.
errors.fix: Record database mein hai ya nahi check karo, ya migration/seed chalao.

debug.body: MVC flow ko step-by-step dekhne ke liye har layer mein `dd()` ya `logger()` lagao, aur `route:list` se route check karo.

code.code:
php artisan route:list --path=products
php artisan make:model Product -m
php artisan make:controller ProductController

quiz.why: M = Model, jo data aur database ka kaam sambhalta hai.

quiz.q: Laravel mein views kahan rakhte hain?
Controller ka sahi kaam kaunsa hai?
quiz.why: Controller request handle karke model/service se kaam karwata hai aur response deta hai.

interview.a: Model-View-Controller design pattern jo application ko data (Model), UI (View) aur request handling (Controller) mein baantta hai.

interview.q: Laravel MVC strictly follow karta hai?
interview.a: Nahi, flexible hai. Model, View, Controller ke saath Form Requests, Services, Jobs, Policies jaise extra layers bhi hote hain.
Jab controller mein bahut logic bhar jaati hai, to testing aur reuse mushkil ho jaata hai. Logic ko model ya service/action classes mein rakhna chahiye.
Record mile to return karta hai, warna `ModelNotFoundException` throw karta hai jo 404 response banta hai.

interview.q: View ko data kaise bhejte hain?

summary: Model data, View UI, Controller request ka coordinator.
Route request ko controller se jodta hai.
Controller patla rakho, logic alag classes mein.
Laravel MVC flexible hai, extra layers add kar sakte ho.
